definitions.cold_model_load: within each run and cold cell, compute R7 p50 of successful-trial metrics.model_load_ms
definitions.coverage: every configured exact cell must contain the same run_ids; each run must contain trial_index 1..measurement.<warm_state>.measured_iterations_per_run
definitions.failures: sum root failure_count across all trials in a cell
definitions.peak_vram_relative_range: take each run's maximum successful-trial metrics.peak_vram_bytes, then (max-min)/R7 median across runs
definitions.pooled_itl: within each run and warm cell, pool every actual per-token value from successful requests[].itl_ms arrays and compute R7 p50/p95
definitions.r7: sort x; h=(n-1)*p; linearly interpolate x[floor(h)] and x[ceil(h)]
definitions.request_mean_tpot: within each run and warm cell, flatten successful request-level requests[].mean_tpot_ms observations and compute R7 p50/p95
definitions.sample_cv: across independent runs, sample standard deviation / abs(mean)
definitions.throughput: within each run and cell, compute R7 p50 of successful-trial metrics.output_tokens_per_second; report its sample CV for every cell, but apply throughput_cv_max only to warm cells because a cold run has one diagnostic first-request observation
definitions.token_identity: for each cell, trial_index, and request position, require identical prompt_token_ids_sha256 and generated_token_ids_sha256 across runs
definitions.warm_latency: within each run and warm cell, flatten successful requests[].end_to_end_ms across trials and compute R7 p50/p95

known_limitations: only the four PR-01 repeatability cells are included
one lane and one primary environment are evaluated
large external model and profiler artifacts are not imported

preparation.policy: the pinned managed Python is resolved and verified; uv lock synchronization is offline into one fresh external project environment; the selected lane primes every distinct repeatability compile profile in fresh unmeasured subprocesses

reproducibility_environment.inheritance: runtime subprocesses receive one exact sanitized environment; unrelated or secret ambient values are not inherited
